svg.title: Beltline machine catalogue
svg.desc: One of each machine kind in the Beltline kit, joined by belts. Inserter arms load and unload the stores, a diverter flap picks a route, a hash pointer finds a bucket, and an LRU moves a node to the front of its list.
svg.text: Every kit machine with sample values. Illustrative, not a recording.

g.text: 1/36 an inserter lifts the item off the rack and onto the belt
2/36 ring buffer: c lands in the tail sector and the tail arm turns
3/36 hash map: h(k3) = 2, so the pointer drops to bucket 2
4/36 insertion sort: the arm lifts 3, 7 shifts right, and 3 goes in front
5/36 LRU: get(a) hashes to bucket 0 and finds node 2
6/36 the arm lifts a off the LRU end, the others slide down, a goes to MRU
7/36 the tokenizer cuts a number and hands it to the branch
8/36 branch: kind == num, so the flap swings to the upper route
9/36 the press renders a glyph and an inserter drops it on the plate
10/36 the next token is an operator
11/36 branch: else, so the flap swings down and the lock's gate turns
12/36 deque: push_front puts a at the front mouth
13/36 pop_back sends d on; the heap receives 1 in its last slot
14/36 heap: 1 is smaller than its parent 4, so they swap
15/36 1 is smaller than the root 3, swap again: the minimum is on top
16/36 bloom filter: three hashes of cat light bits 2, 7 and 10
17/36 DP table: each cell is filled from the one above and to the left
18/36 graph: a traversal visits A, then follows the edge to B
19/36 B's only edge leads to C, which A also reaches directly
20/36 the visit is published as an event
21/36 broadcast: every subscriber gets a copy; the counter ticks, the arena bumps
22/36 merge: both streams join into one
23/36 the joined result reaches the subscriber
24/36 WAL: commit is appended at the head and the commit mark moves up to it
25/36 slotted page: a new slot points at b=2, written from the bottom up
26/36 B+tree: 8 < 10, so the search goes down the first child
27/36 8 lands in the first leaf, still in sorted order
28/36 trie: looking up cat follows c
30/36 then t, a terminal node: cat is in the trie
31/36 pool: a worker checks out connection c2 to serve request 8
32/36 token bucket: request 9 takes a token; three are left
33/36 timer wheel: the hand ticks on and t3 is filed four slots ahead
34/36 double buffer: the next frame is drawn into the back pane
35/36 swap: the back pane becomes the one on screen
36/36 spatial grid: p1 crosses into the next cell; the split cell holds two
